pairs.evidence: src/api/agents/evolution.ts:104 Every readiness gate goes through this one probe, and it merges 'installed' and 'authorized' into a single rejection. The backend maps both to AppError::Internal (src-tauri/src/commands/execution/evolution.rs:167). The wrapper never sends the backend's existing `force` flag, so a cached probe that a real run has since proved wrong cannot be re-probed from the client.

techniques.evidence: src/api/agents/evolution.ts:108 No force parameter is passed, and installed vs authorized are not told apart, against the technique's 'two separate questions' rule.

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/src/engine/build_session/fix_pass.rs:202 A generate call runs with the bypass stance. The standard says auto-accept, never bypass, and generate gets no workspace grants at all.

pairs.evidence: src/stores/slices/system/uiSlice.ts:46 The morning-briefing provenance records which rung served the briefing but not why it descended. The backend turns every compose error into Ok(None) with only a log line (src-tauri/src/commands/companion/briefing.rs:62). CLI absent, timeout, parse failure and empty output all collapse into 'fallback', so a fleet that has quietly fallen back to the deterministic floor cannot be diagnosed from the surface.
